summary: You can undo a link on the Access map, and Pending changes is faster and easier to read.

new.title: Undo a staged link
new.text: On the Access map, Ctrl+click a staged link again, drop on it again or press the x to take it back. Committed links must be revoked instead.

fixes.title: No duplicate links
fixes.text: Repeating a click can no longer stage the same link twice, and repeated messages no longer stack up.

fixes.title: Pending changes loads faster
fixes.text: Discarded entries are loaded only when you tick Show discarded. The counts still cover everything, and failed entries are always shown.

fixes.title: Pending changes in plain words
fixes.text: Entries now say what they do, for example cataloguing a named Entra ID role, instead of showing a technical key.

fixes.title: Discovery follows your policy
fixes.text: Role discovery now respects the Discovery policy you set. With flag, it only reports what it found and queues nothing.
